name: momentum-crypto-cooldown-v1
description: Post-stop re-entry cooldown for the TSM crypto sleeve, pre-registered 2026-09-02 BEFORE any run, on the axis shipped this same day in the simulator (cooldownBarsAfterStop: after a HARD-STOP close — and only a hard stop; signal-flip/trail/time exits do not arm it — the symbol is blocked for N decision bars). Live motivation, dated: 2026-09-02 SOL/USDC stopped out 10:32 (-$67 BROKER_STOP_LOSS) and re-entered 11:24 the same day; the stock twin shows the same class at larger scale (GLD 5 entries in 14 days, NVDA re-entered the day after its trail stop for a further -$621). The stop already said the thesis failed at current prices; re-entering one bar later re-pays entry costs for the same information. Declared case AGAINST, stated up front: TSM signal persistence is genuine — after a shakeout stop the resumed trend is sometimes the best entry, and a cooldown forfeits exactly those; the 251-trial legacy grid never swept this axis so there is no prior either way. EVERYTHING except cooldownBarsAfterStop is FROZEN to experiments/momentum-crypto-v1.json (e5x2, 0.375, maxLongs 4, no shorts, same data/window/costs/gates, asOf pinned 2026-07-15). 3 candidates declared up front, none trimmed after results: incumbent-no-cooldown (absent — execution-identity rerun, adds 0 new hypotheses), cooldown-4 (4 decision bars = 4h at production cadence), cooldown-12 (12h). priorUniqueTrials=263: 261 after momentum-crypto-sizing-v1 plus momentum-crypto-e8x2-sizing-v1's 2 size variants (registered earlier this same day). The 2 cooldown variants here are new hypotheses. Inventory incomplete, so complete=false and approval stays blocked by protocol regardless of gates.
